input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting the weeds in the communal garden, the overgrown hedge along the side path and the uncleared land at the side of Flat 26, 46 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ5 7ZZ (ref R/PM001-1).

We've passed this to the landlord. They've told us a site visit has taken place with a contractor and quotes for the works are now awaited. Nothing has been booked yet. We'll update you once we hear more.

If the side path becomes blocked or unsafe to use in the meantime, please let us know straight away.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
